title: Widespread 401 errors in payment-service after token signing key rotation
summary: Following a scheduled rotation of the JWT signing key, payment-service began rejecting a large fraction of valid requests with 401 Unauthorized, because tokens issued just before the rotation could no longer be verified.
root_cause: The key rotation process removed the old signing key immediately instead of keeping it valid for verification during a grace period, invalidating still-live tokens.
fix: Changed the rotation process to keep the previous key valid for verification (but not issuing) for 6 hours after rotation, giving in-flight tokens time to expire naturally.
